title: Check If All 1's Are at Least Length K Places Away
summary: Determine if all 1's in the binary array are at least k positions apart, returning true if so, otherwise false.
statement: Determine if all 1's in the binary array are at least k positions apart, returning true if so, otherwise false.
constraints: Between every pair of consecutive ones there must be at least k zeroes.
hints: Remember the index of the previous one.
At a new one, index difference must exceed k because the zero count is difference minus one.
Update the remembered position after validation.
Only consecutive ones need checking; any farther pair has an even larger gap.
editorial: Only consecutive ones need checking; any farther pair has an even larger gap.

tests.explanation: The gaps contain three and then two zeroes, both sufficient.
Only one zero separates the two ones.
